cohort: The study included 468,778 eligible women who contributed 912,747 singleton livebirths between 1980 and 2015 in Western Australia.
finding: Pregnancies in women with endometriosis were associated with an increased risk of preeclampsia (RR 1.18), placenta previa (RR 1.59), and preterm birth (RR 1.45), independent of Medically Assisted Reproduction.
